title: Format example — planted founding-date contradiction

questions.question: When was the Nimbus Cartography Collective founded?
questions.plantedFact: src-01 says founded in 2011; src-02 says began operations in early 2012. Semantically the same question, phrased differently, so it cannot be caught by string matching.

questions.question: Where is the collective based?
questions.plantedFact: Both sources independently place it in Rotterdam.

questions.question: How many people did the collective employ?
questions.plantedFact: Only src-01 reports headcount (twelve people by 2019). A single-source question is still agreed, not disputed.

notes: Minimal worked example of the fixture-case format, reusing the two format-example source documents. The real corpus lives alongside it in set-a-agreement.case.json, set-b-contradiction.case.json, and set-c-poisoned.case.json; this file stays as the smallest committed reference for the format, small enough to read in one screen, and CI validates it like any other case.
